title: 2008 HMMT February Guts Problem 7
statement: Given that \(x+\sin y=2008\) and \(x+2008 \cos y=2007\), where \(0 \leq y \leq \pi / 2\), find the value of \(x+y\).

solutions.text: \(2007+\frac{\pi}{2}\) Subtracting the two equations gives \(\sin y-2008 \cos y=1\). But since \(0 \leq y \leq \pi / 2\), the maximum of \(\sin y\) is 1 and the minimum of \(\cos y\) is 0 , so we must have \(\sin y=1\), so \(y=\pi / 2\) and \(x+y=2007+\frac{\pi}{2}\).
